baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence 'the Living - no deity except Him - therefore call Him.'
baseline_models.mechanism: The positive identification as living presence, the negation-exception that removes every other deity, and the consequential fa-imperative form one argument: the sole living divine addressee is the one to whom speech is directed.

activation_trace.role: Animate life supplies the positive predicate and makes the commanded address an address to living presence.
Worship and the worshiped one supply the class wholly excluded from rivals and then identify the recipient of praise.
Voiced calling supplies the human action that follows from exclusive living divinity.

changed_reading.before: A divine attribute is stated and a separate instruction to pray follows.
changed_reading.after: The command to call is the direct consequence of identifying one living and exclusive divine addressee.

baseline_models.mechanism: The active participants remove admixture from their obedience and assign that obedience to one recipient; sincerity is therefore an operation on allegiance, not only an inward feeling.

activation_trace.role: Purification after mixture supplies the removal operation performed on the following allegiance.
Exclusive allocation away from partnership supplies the relational destination marked by 'for Him.'
Obedience and submission supply the whole practice being purified and reassigned.

changed_reading.before: Call on God while feeling sincere.
changed_reading.after: Actively clear the entire field of obedience from shared claims and render it to Him alone.

baseline_models.mechanism: The closing nominal declaration evaluates God's acts as praiseworthy and assigns that praise to the master who tends, repairs, and completes every order under His care.

activation_trace.role: Praise opposed to blame supplies an evaluative verdict rather than a bare acclamation.
Mastery and ownership supply the universal scope of the one to whom praise belongs.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the continuing activity for which the Lord is praised.

changed_reading.before: The verse ends with a conventional doxology.
changed_reading.after: The ending is a verdict that all praise answers the ongoing cultivation and completion of every realm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier call pattern makes exclusivity socially contested: calling God alone provokes refusal, adding a partner reverses that refusal, and the focus wording is rehearsed under explicit hostility. Purification of din thus includes refusing redistributed worship under counterpressure.

activation_trace.role: Exclusive allocation anchors the changed reading in the focus participle and its rejection of partnership.
Audible invocation supplies the public act around which acceptance and rejection reverse.
Divine oneness without a partner supplies the contested condition of that invocation.
Association with God supplies the rival arrangement that the purified allegiance excludes.
Exclusive dedication recurs in the same command while surrounding hostility makes its public cost visible.

structural_cues: 40:12 reverses the audience's response according to whether God is invoked alone or associated with another.
40:14 repeats the focus command and adds that it stands even when disbelievers hate it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a response reversal and an exact earlier rehearsal under hostility; I infer that external counterpressure is one impurity being removed. A live alternative is that the repetition only stresses inward sincerity.

changed_reading.before: Purity describes a private devotional state.
changed_reading.after: Purity is also the public maintenance of undivided allegiance when a surrounding audience rewards shared worship and resists sole invocation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus imperative opens a direct speech relation: the Lord commands calling, immediately promises an answer, and names proud refusal as refusal of worship. Calling is therefore enacted obedient access, not merely the delivery of requests.

activation_trace.role: Voiced calling anchors the focus command as one side of a relational exchange.
Direct address supplies the initiating human speech that the Lord explicitly solicits.
A returned utterance supplies the answering side of the call and makes the relation bidirectional.
Submissive worship identifies the call as obedience and exposes refusal as proud non-participation.

structural_cues: 40:60 places 'call Me' and 'I answer you' in immediate imperative-response sequence.
The same ayah moves without a new subject from refusal to call into arrogance toward worship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate call-answer syntax and the worship label; I infer that the focus imperative establishes responsive access as a mode of worship. A live alternative is that worship names a broader category while prayer is only one example.

changed_reading.before: The imperative means to make petitions to God.
changed_reading.after: The imperative enters a promised call-answer relation whose very enactment is humble worship and whose refusal is arrogance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah stages reciprocal invitations toward rescue and fire, then forbids worship of those called apart from God and commands surrender to the Lord of the worlds. Mukhlisina becomes an extraction from an active network of rival summons and claims.

activation_trace.role: Escape from entanglement anchors purity as release from competing summons rather than only removal of an internal blemish.
Reciprocal voiced invitations supply two opposed directional pulls within one exchange.
Rescue by separation supplies the destination of one call and the extraction mechanism later carried by purity.
Shared claims supply the social-religious entanglement toward which the rival invitation pulls.
Handing over and relinquishing control supplies the positive completion of withdrawing allegiance from rival addressees.

structural_cues: 40:41-43 presents two parties calling each other toward opposed outcomes and denies efficacy to the rival object.
40:66 contrasts worship of those called apart from God with commanded surrender to the Lord of the worlds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed invitations, rescue by separation, and commanded surrender; I infer a directional arrow from purification to disengagement and then reattachment to God. A live alternative is to keep mukhlisina at the narrower level of unmixed intention.

changed_reading.before: Sincere callers concentrate mentally on God.
changed_reading.after: Callers are pulled free from rival invitation systems and hand the whole field of allegiance to the Lord of the worlds.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human power selectively kills and leaves alive, but the closing sequence attributes both giving life and causing death to God and joins them to effective command. The focus title shifts from static immortality to sovereign, productive livingness.

activation_trace.role: Possession of life anchors the title whose agency the later sequence unfolds.
Human sparing from death supplies a coercive, selective imitation of control over life.
Animating life supplies the active outward exercise of the focus title.
Removal of life supplies the paired boundary over which the same agent has control.
Coming into occurrence at a time supplies the effective transition produced by divine command.

structural_cues: 40:25 places killing and selective preservation of life inside Pharaoh's coercive policy.
40:68 gives God both sides of life and death and immediately follows them with command and occurrence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a human regime's selective sparing and God's paired life-death-command sequence; I infer a reversal from pretended control to originating sovereignty. A live alternative is that 40:25 is only historical background and 40:68 only resurrection proof.

changed_reading.before: The Living names the one who does not die.
changed_reading.after: The Living names the one whose life is productive sovereignty: He originates life, sets its mortal boundary, and makes commanded being occur.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding sequence turns cosmic order into inhabitable benefit: night is appointed for rest, earth stabilized, sky structured, bodies formed well, and good provision allotted. The focus praise is the answering evaluation of experienced nurture.

activation_trace.role: Praise for praiseworthy action anchors the focus ending as an evaluation of the supplied benefits.
Making something serve a condition supplies deliberate conversion of night and day into a humanly usable order.
Fixity and stability supply the ground condition that makes earthly dwelling possible.
An allotted gift supplies concrete nourishment as an outcome of Lordly care.
Nurture and completion name the agent behind the ordered habitat and directly prepare the repeated focus title.

structural_cues: 40:61-64 accumulates rest, visibility, bounty, creation, stability, shelter, good form, and provision.
40:64 ends with the same Lord-of-the-worlds designation that closes 40:65, making praise adjacent to its material grounds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a benefit catalogue and an immediately repeated Lord-title; I infer that the following praise answers those benefits as their proper evaluation. A live alternative is that the praise remains a general doxology not restricted to the adjacent catalogue.

changed_reading.before: Praise is an abstract statement of divine worth.
changed_reading.after: Praise rises as the fitting response to a world made stable, inhabitable, well-formed, and provisioned by its cultivating Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: Praise with glorification is already performed around the throne and prescribed across evening and morning. The focus closing can therefore be heard as joining a worshipful cadence that spans cosmic rank and daily time.

activation_trace.role: Spoken praise anchors the terminal declaration as an act that can be joined and repeated.
Worship through glorification supplies the throne-bearing community's mode of continuous praise.
Praise supplies the shared verbal substance linking the cosmic speakers to the focus ending.
Care and completion identify the praised Lord as the one whose mercy and knowledge the speakers invoke for others.
Declaring transcendence supplies the repeated practice into which praise is woven at the day's two edges.
Praise supplies the recurring daily wording that the focus declaration gathers into its close.

structural_cues: 40:7 locates glorification with praise among the throne-bearers and those around it.
40:55 schedules glorification with praise at evening and morning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same praise root in a cosmic assembly and a daily schedule; I infer that the focus speaker enters an already ongoing cadence. A live alternative is that these are separate ritual instructions with no implied chorus at 40:65.

changed_reading.before: The final praise is a one-time sentence spoken by the present reciter.
changed_reading.after: The reciter's praise joins a cadence already sounding around the throne and across the recurring boundaries of the day.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because al-alamin is lexicalized as 'the worlds,' not translated as 'marks.' It remains anchored in the focus root's marker branch and is activated by the surah's repeated display of visible signs. Downstream prose should present it only as a root-level resonance: the worlds may be heard as differentiated, legible orders that point beyond themselves.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: al-alamin at word 14, governed by rabb.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that guides supplies a root-level echo within the focus designation for the worlds.
Causing something to appear supplies divine disclosure as the action that makes the surrounding order legible.
An evident sign supplies the displayed unit through which that disclosure points.
Repeated showing supplies a whole-surah return to disclosure immediately before the challenge of denial.
Repeated evident signs supply the legible plurality that can be recognized or rejected.

changed_reading.before: The worlds are the total collection ruled by God.
changed_reading.after: As a contained root echo, the worlds are also differentiated signs: a legible plurality whose markings disclose the care of their Lord.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the financial-debt image must not replace din's primary obedience/religion sense. It remains anchored in the focus root and is activated by the surah's explicit compensation and reckoning language. Downstream prose should qualify it as an account or obligation resonance, not as a translation.

activation_trace.role: Financial debt supplies the exploratory image of an obligation whose competing claims must be cleared.
Purification after admixture supplies the clearing operation applied to that obligation.
Exacting and settling a debt supplies a judgment-scene analogue for bringing obligations to account.
Counting and reckoning supply the accounting horizon within which undivided obligation matters.

changed_reading.before: The callers practice sincere religion for God.
changed_reading.after: As a secondary resonance, they present the whole account of obligation cleared of rival creditors and answerable to God alone.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the retained-milk branch is a husbandry image and cannot define the imperative's lexical sense. It remains anchored in the focus call root and gains a visible mechanism from 40:60's immediate promised answer. Downstream prose should render it only as a material analogy: a call can be imagined as a small initiating remainder that draws a following response.

activation_trace.role: A retained starter that draws what follows supplies the odd material image of initiation eliciting further flow.
Voiced address supplies the actual context action to which the material analogy is attached.
A returned answer supplies the subsequent flow that the initiating call is imagined to draw.

changed_reading.before: A call is a message sent toward a distant recipient.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the call is an initiating trace within a live relation, drawing the promised answering movement that follows it.

strongest_changes: Purified din becomes publicly undivided allegiance maintained against pressure to share worship.
Calling becomes responsive worship: solicited speech met by a promised answer rather than one-way petition.
The Living becomes the active source and sovereign boundary of life, death, and commanded occurrence.
Praise becomes the answer to a concretely stabilized and provisioned world and joins an ongoing cosmic-daily cadence.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly re-staged the focus wording: an exact call-with-pure-din rehearsal at 40:14, opposed invitations at 40:41-43, the call-answer-worship sequence at 40:60, a dense provision-and-Lordship lead-in at 40:61-64, and the life-death-command expansion at 40:68. These sequences turned a compact doxological imperative into several coexisting mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The degree to which mukhlisina marks public social separation rather than primarily inward intention remains open.
The sign, debt-account, and retained-starter models are root-level resonances and material analogies, not secure lexical substitutions.
The final praise may join the surah's cosmic and daily cadence without that participation being grammatically explicit in the focus ayah.
